Our standards

Evidence before speed.

We aim to link to original sources, distinguish reported claims from independently established facts, and explain uncertainty. Different websites are not necessarily independent if they rely on the same reporting.

AI-assisted work

We may use locally hosted AI to help research or prepare drafts. AI can make mistakes, invent details or misread sources. A human editor is responsible for reviewing and approving every article before publication. Sources are linked so readers can inspect them.

Corrections

When we discover a material mistake, we review the evidence and update the article with an explanation. See our corrections policy.

Independence

We aim to distinguish news from opinion or analysis, identify promotional material, and disclose relevant relationships when applicable.
